headline: On October 28, 1971: Prospero launched by British Black Arrow rocket
captionCards: Prospero was contacted annually for over 25 years after launch
This mission showcased the UK's early space tech capabilities
instagramCaption:
Prospero, the only British satellite launched by a British rocket. \\[Blank Line] On October 28, 1971, the United Kingdom successfully launched the Prospero satellite using the Black Arrow rocket. Designed to study the space environment's effects on communications satellites, Prospero remained operational until 1973 and was contacted annually for over 25 years. This achievement marked a significant milestone in British space technology. \\[Blank Line] Why does it still matter today?
